changelog: Your units now GREY OUT once they've spent every action, so a glance tells you who still has something left — deliberately lighter than the EMP-bricked look, and skipped for buildings that never act. The deploy screen no longer stacks up ascension rules until it squeezes everything else off the panel: one button now opens the full list, which also spells out that the tiers stack. Switching commanders resets the ascension tier to 0 — it's earned per commander — and the picker greys out at that commander's own ceiling instead of silently refusing. The demo now starts with TWO of each cosmetic (board chips, fog sets and tile selectors) so the collection screens are actually worth opening.
